newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Six Asians arrested after Costa Rica shootout.
newsitem.headline: Six Asians arrested after Costa Rica shootout.

text.p: Costa Rican police said on Friday they had arrested six suspected members of an Asian gang involved in international money laundering, drug trafficking and extortion.

The arrests late Thursday in southeastern San Jose followed a shootout with police in which one police officer and one suspect, an 18-year-old man identified only by the surname Ho, were wounded, police said.
Five men and one woman were arrested. Police said they believed they were from Hong Kong.
A report by Costa Rica's Judicial Investigations Office said authorities took action after a two-month investigation.

Police who attempted to enter the gang's rented house were met by gunfire, resulting in an exchange of fire, the report said. The two people wounded in the shootout were reported to be in the hospital and out of danger.
The OIJ report said the arrested people were suspected members of a gang that lent money to Costa Rican clients, using violence to collect from bad debtors.
